title: Shark's Enchant Cap
description: Makes a Lower Max Level for Some Enchants, Aimed at Events
body:
**THIS IS NOT SETUP FOR BASIC GAMEPLAY AND IS TARGETED AT EVENTS**

---
Goal of this pack is Limiting Enchants like Protection and Sharpness for Events which Don't want players using things stronger than that

**Currently Only Limits The Following Enchants**
- Sharp 1 Max
- Prot 2 Max
- Power 2 Max

This is Expected to be played with some enchants disabled, without those disabled things start to break
Disabled Enchants are,
- Fire Aspect
- Looting
- Soul Speed
- Frost Walker
- Flame
- Infinity

Future Plans as of now (not set in stone ofc)
- Fix small issues
- Optimize
